section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 12, Österbybruk-Risön
section.notes: Roslagen rounds to ca 20 km; keep 19 km from Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen.

bounds.note: Iteration 5 bounds cover GPX endpoints, current normal/pending/suppression row coordinates, and the live Etapp 12 GPX easternmost point. Recompute from full GPX during final integration if exact route-only bounds are needed.

drawPolicy: Use Etapp 12 GPX as the official downloadable geometry for the section.
One GPX track and one segment; no large internal gaps found in iteration 1.
Do not blindly join adjacent raw GPX endpoints: Etapp 11 has an auxiliary segment and Etapp 13 GPX is stored Lövstabruk-to-Risön, reversed relative to the written walking direction.

Current Etapp 12 GPX is eastern-branch geometry after Vika. Official prose still treats western Stormon/Grillholmen as a valid branch, but that branch is absent from the primary GPX and should not be normal-imported until alternate branch geometry is supported.
qa: Naturkartan site id 9548: GPX endpoint checked available; API shape is a one-line MultiLineString with 347 coordinate points.
Current GPX tracks the eastern route choice after Vika; Stormon and Grillholmen are kept pending until branch handling is settled.
Facility/safety warnings found in iteration 1: Vika pump has non-potable water; Risön water is seasonal May-October. Access metadata separately records that Risön has no bus access.
Iteration 2 confirmed Floranslingan GPX supplies alternate geometry near Stormon and Grillholmen, while Etapp 12 primary GPX follows Staffansholmen/Kungaspången.

apiQa.note: Direct API fetch currently returns invalid api key; public page still exposes site id 9548 and GPX endpoint remains usable. Do not rely on unauthenticated API shape for import QA.

alternateBranches.name: Western branch after Vika via Stormon and Grillholmen
alternateBranches.geometryNote: Floranslingan GPX is a 3-segment official loop/network. Use it as alternate-branch evidence only; do not merge it into the primary Etapp 12 GPX.
alternateBranches.importPolicy: Keep pending until branch-scoped facility metadata is supported by the importer/app.

importRows.name: Toalett, Österbybruk torget
importRows.notes: Shared start endpoint service. Public toilet at torget, open year-round 07-21. Deduplicate with Etapp 11 endpoint records. Dedupe with Etapp 11 and Österbybruksslingan.

importRows.name: Vatten, Österbybruk
importRows.notes: Shared start endpoint service. Municipal tap outside laundry, on year-round. Deduplicate with Etapp 11 endpoint records. Dedupe with Etapp 11 and Österbybruksslingan.

importRows.name: RWC, Österbybruk busstation
importRows.notes: Shared start endpoint service. Östhammar municipality lists Österbybruk Bussväntsalen as 1 RWC open 24h. No separate RWC map point was found; coordinate is rechecked against the Naturkartan Österbybruk busstation anchor, so confidence remains medium. Dedupe with Etapp 11 and Österbybruksslingan using fuzzy/source-name matching because Etapp 11 used a coordinate about 18 m away.

importRows.name: Toalett, Films kyrka
importRows.notes: Toilet in white outbuilding outside the church wall, open year-round.

importRows.name: Vatten, Films kyrka
importRows.notes: Drinking-water refill at the Films kyrka toilet/service point.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Vika
importRows.notes: Several picnic tables in pasture near Vika; current warning says the Vika water pump has unfit water and must not be used for drinking or cooking. Dedupe/coordinate-check against Floranslingan overlap.

importRows.name: Toalett, Vika
importRows.notes: Dry toilet near Vika rest area. Dedupe/coordinate-check against Floranslingan overlap.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Staffansholmen
importRows.notes: Official fireplace/rest area near Vikasjön on the current GPX/eastern branch. Do not import as shelter unless a later pass confirms official shelter status. Dedupe/coordinate-check against Floranslingan overlap.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Staffansholmen
importRows.notes: Rest area with benches associated with the Staffansholmen fireplace. Import only if same-coordinate clustering is respected. Dedupe/coordinate-check against Floranslingan overlap.

importRows.name: Öppen raststuga, Risön
importRows.notes: Open rest/overnight cabin with two beds and electric heat; no cooking. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan. Länsstyrelsen distinguishes these public visitor services from bookable indoor Risön amenities; dedupe with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan.

importRows.name: Vatten, Risön
importRows.notes: Seasonal tap on building at Risön, available May-October / May 1-October 31 only. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan. Länsstyrelsen distinguishes these public visitor services from bookable indoor Risön amenities; dedupe with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan. Länsstyrelsen is used as contextual support for public-vs-bookable Risön services; the seasonal public tap itself is directly sourced from Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen.

importRows.name: Toalett, Risön
importRows.notes: Dry toilet/public endpoint toilet at Risön. Exact service should be deduplicated with Risön object and Etapp 13/Floranslingan imports. Länsstyrelsen distinguishes these public visitor services from bookable indoor Risön amenities; dedupe with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Risön
importRows.notes: Risön trail endpoint/lägergård context with public outdoor rest and grill area. Indoor lodging, showers and kitchen are bookable amenities, not public trail facilities. Länsstyrelsen distinguishes these public visitor services from bookable indoor Risön amenities; dedupe with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Risön
importRows.notes: Outdoor grill/fireplace at Risön, with wood according to Naturkartan/Roslagen context. Shared endpoint service. Länsstyrelsen distinguishes these public visitor services from bookable indoor Risön amenities; dedupe with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan.

importRows.name: Films kyrka
importRows.notes: Medieval church context on Etapp 12; Naturkartan and Svenska kyrkan describe 1400s origin/paintings and later extension.

importRows.name: Gravfält vid Film
importRows.notes: Cluster interpretation: official route text says the route passes a larger grave field with about 50 Iron Age graves after road 290. Fornsök confirms route-adjacent RAÄ Film 9:1/L1943:3137 and Film 34:1/L1943:3351 as grave fields, with nearby off-route Film 10:1/L1943:3269 making the count plausible. Coordinate is an approximate cluster marker, not a single RAÄ object centroid; keep medium confidence.

importRows.name: Kungaspången
importRows.notes: Named 500 m boardwalk over mire between Stenstamon and Risön; coordinate is on the official Etapp 12 GPX/current eastern branch. Route-feature POI, not a facility.

importRows.name: Tältplats, Risön
importRows.notes: Public tent spots at Risön. Supported by Naturkartan Risön, Etapp 13 endpoint context and Länsstyrelsen Florarna public visitor-service guidance. Dedupe with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan.

importRows.name: Filmspången
importRows.notes: Named on-route foot bridge after road 290. Coordinate is the midpoint of the OSM bridge way on Upplandsleden and falls on the official Etapp 12 GPX. Nearby bird tower is mapped at 60.2254768, 17.9056429, about 9 m from the official GPX, and is treated as supporting context rather than a separate import.

suppressions.name: Österbybruk busstation

suppressions.name: Parkering, Österbybruk
suppressions.notes: Shared start parking metadata. Large asphalt parking by busstation serving Etapp 11, Etapp 12 and Österbybruksslingan. Keep out of normal facility imports.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Vika
suppressions.notes: Small parking for 3-4 cars; do not drive past the gate; plowed in winter. Access metadata only.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Risön
suppressions.notes: Parking at Risön for about 10 cars; plowed in winter. Shared endpoint access metadata with Etapp 13 and Floranslingan.

suppressions.name: No bus access to Risön
suppressions.notes: Official Etapp 12 source says Risön cannot be reached by bus. Do not infer transit at Risön.

suppressions.name: Vattenpump, Vika
suppressions.notes: Suppress as drinkable water. Official current warning says the Vika pump has unfit water and must not be used for drinking or cooking.

suppressions.name: Florarna reserve rules
suppressions.notes: Reserve context/rules metadata: fire only at prepared places; dogs leashed; vehicles/camping governed by reserve rules. Do not import as a normal point facility.

suppressions.name: Österbybruk endpoint services
suppressions.notes: Official text lists hotel, camping, grocery, restaurant, cafe and bakery in Österbybruk. Keep as endpoint service metadata unless discrete trail-use coordinates are verified.

suppressions.name: Österbybruk heritage cluster
suppressions.notes: Österbybruk Herrgård/Vallonsmedjan/bruksmiljö are important start context, but Etapp 11 already has Vallonsmedjan as a normal endpoint heritage POI at the same cluster and Etapp 12 imports the actionable start services. Keep metadata-only to avoid duplicate endpoint POIs.

suppressions.name: Hembygdsgården, Österbybruk
suppressions.notes: Local heritage object near Österbybruk, but off the core Etapp 12 start corridor and better handled as Österbybruk local-loop context unless later import policy wants start-area POIs.

suppressions.name: Florarna naturreservat
suppressions.notes: Area/reserve context only in iteration 1. Named facilities inside the reserve are represented separately; do not import a generic reserve marker unless app wants area POIs.

suppressions.name: Staffansholmen shelter claim
suppressions.notes: Suppress as shelter/overnight shelter. Official Naturkartan object lists Staffansholmen as fireplace/rest area, not shelter.

suppressions.name: Torpet Västergärde
suppressions.notes: Rental/bookable accommodation context west of Risön, not a public shelter/campsite/service. Naturkartan and Länsstyrelsen describe it as bookable rental accommodation; it may become western-branch context only if alternate branch POIs are later supported. Do not convert this metadata row into a public shelter/campsite/service import.

suppressions.name: Risön booked indoor amenities
suppressions.notes: Treat Risön indoor WC/showers/kitchen/hot-cold water as booked accommodation amenities. Public trail services are dry toilet, seasonal water tap, tent spots/outdoor rest area and open hut. Do not convert this metadata row into a public shelter/campsite/service import.

suppressions.name: Floranslingan / Upplandsleden slinga 12:2
suppressions.notes: Loop/context only. It shares Risön/Vika/Staffansholmen and describes Stormon/Grillholmen; dedupe by source URL/coords and avoid duplicating loop-wide services as separate Etapp 12 rows.

suppressions.name: Kulturstigen / Österbybrukslingan 12:1
suppressions.notes: Local cultural-route context around Österbybruk, but trail geometry rather than a point POI.

suppressions.name: Etapp 13 / Lövstabruk leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 13 leakage except shared Risön endpoint records, including the Risön campsite row if present. Do not import Finnsjön rest/swimming, Lövstabruk services, Barnens bruk parking, Lövstabruk herrgården transit or Nybron/railway context into Etapp 12.

suppressions.name: Old iron-ore transport path Dannemora-Lövstabruk

suppressions.name: Western branch Stormon/Grillholmen branch policy
suppressions.notes: Resolved in iteration 2 into discrete pending western-branch facility rows. Current Etapp 12 primary GPX is eastern branch; official prose and Floranslingan geometry support western branch facilities, but normal import waits for alternate-branch support.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Stormon
suppressions.notes: Western-branch/Floranslingan access metadata only. Official marker says Upplandsleden passes the parking and it is plowed in winter; current Etapp 12 GPX/import policy keeps Stormon/Grillholmen pending, so do not normal-import.

suppressions.name: Norrbergskojan
suppressions.notes: Metadata-only for Etapp 12 normal import. Naturkartan and Länsstyrelsen confirm Norrbergskojan as an open rest/overnight hut and Naturkartan lists toilet, but it is about 416 m off current eastern GPX and Florarna local text describes access mainly via ice/frozen wetlands or awkward routes. Do not normal-import without mapped spur/side-trip policy; note source conflict where Florarna local text says no toilet while Naturkartan lists toilet.

decisions.dedupePolicy: Dedupe shared endpoint/access records trailwide by Naturkartan source URL and coordinate: Österbybruk start services with Etapp 11/Österbybruksslingan; use fuzzy/source-name matching for Österbybruk busstation RWC because Etapp 11 and Etapp 12 coordinates differ by about 18 m; Risön endpoint services/access, including campsite, with Etapp 13/Floranslingan; Vika/Staffansholmen with Floranslingan if that loop is imported. Parking/transit rows remain metadata-only.

iterationLog.focus: First compact pass over official route metadata, GPX drawability, facilities, shared Österbybruk endpoint services, Florarna/Risön/Vika context, access warnings, POIs and schema constraints.
iterationLog.result: Created conservative iteration-1 Etapp 12 file: current-GPX/on-route services are normal imports; parking/transit are metadata-only; Stormon/Grillholmen western-branch facilities and weaker POIs remain pending; unsafe Vika water, endpoint duplicates, reserve/loop context and Etapp 13 leakage are suppressed or metadata-only.

iterationLog.focus: Second pass on branch geometry, facilities/source QA, POI resolution, access/leakage metadata and schema hygiene.
iterationLog.result: Confirmed primary Etapp 12 GPX follows eastern branch; split Stormon/Grillholmen into discrete western-branch pending rows using Floranslingan alternate geometry. Promoted Kungaspången and corrected Film grave-field cluster to normal POIs. Added Stormon parking metadata, strengthened Risön public-service sources, and moved Norrbergskojan/Filmspången to context-only suppressions.

iterationLog.focus: Third pass on western-branch metadata, POI precision, facility coordinate/source QA, schema hygiene and context suppression review.
iterationLog.result: Kept Stormon/Grillholmen pending but added explicit branch metadata and primary-vs-alternate GPX distances. Added Risön campsite as a normal public trail facility. Moved Filmspången back to pending pending coordinate verification. Tightened Film grave-field and Kungaspången POI details, exact Vika/Risön coordinates, RWC source wording, current warning semantics and unused source cleanup.

iterationLog.focus: Fourth pass on branch metadata, Filmspången coordinate, facility chainage/proximity, normal POI/context QA and schema polish.
iterationLog.result: Promoted Filmspången to normal on-route attraction using the bridge coordinate. Kept Stormon/Grillholmen pending with branch-scoped metadata and refined alternate-GPX distances. Updated bounds, Films kyrka/Vika/Staffansholmen/Risön chainage and proximity values, fixed Risön campsite sources, tightened Österbybruk RWC dedupe wording, and removed unused source manifest keys.

iterationLog.focus: Final mapdata and schema QA after the agent limit prevented a full five-agent pass.
iterationLog.result: Confirmed the Etapp 12 GPX is drawable as one track/segment with 416 points, about 18.663 km, no >500 m internal gaps, a 61 m previous handoff and a 0 m next handoff when Etapp 13's reversed stored direction is respected. Expanded maxLon to cover the live GPX easternmost point. Kept Stormon/Grillholmen branch facilities pending, with Film grave-field uncertainty retained as a caveat rather than an import blocker.

validation.transportMetadataPolicy: Rows in decisions.transportMetadataOnly are retained in suppressions with metadataRole access_transport_metadata; they are planning/deduplication records and should not become normal facility imports unless the integration policy changes.
validation.mapCanDrawCondition: Draw/use the Etapp 12 GPX as the one-track, one-segment primary route. Preserve the current eastern-branch geometry; keep Stormon/Grillholmen western-branch facilities pending until alternate branch geometry is supported.
validation.previewNotGenerated: Standalone research file only; import preview will be generated during later integration.
